item.title: California chief justice steps up monitoring of immigration arrests at courthouses
item.description: California’s top judge wants to deter immigration agents from making arrests in courthouses, a practice that she says instills fear in witnesses and litigants. item.title: Long Beach coffee shop closes after being ordered to pay $65,000 in back wages
item.description: A judge ruled the East Village Café was liable for minimum wage violations and overtime that was never paid. The post Long Beach coffee shop closes after being ordered to pay $65,000 in back wages appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Construction starts on 272-unit apartment complex, part of a larger downtown development plan
item.description: It’s part of a wider project that’s expected to eventually bring 900 apartments and 50 new storefronts. The first building, called Portico, is slated to finish by June 2028. item.title: Supreme Court lets California use new Congressional maps designed to boost Democrats
